listing.title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1985-06-30

recording.lineage: Master recording by Tom Strizak (*first show with new mics) 2- Sennheiser MD441 mounted in standard stereo configuration Sony TC-D5M (dolby - On B) > TDK MA90 Cassette. Location: Taper Section on lawn slightly right of center approx. 10' back from last row of pavillion seating. This resulted in a combination of sound mainly coming directly from delay speakers which were used to propagate sound outward to the lawn area, and just a small portion of the sound coming from inside the pavillion. | Analog Master cassette played back on Nakamichi CR-1A > Behringer XR-18 audio mixer > ZOOM H-5 digital recorder 24bit/48Khz WAV > Reaper v7.61 *DAW (final audio editing and mastering) > Audacity *DAW (tracking and conversion from WAV file to FLAC 24bit 48khz file set) > LMA for upload (*DAW = Digital Audio Worksatation)
